visualCharacteristics: New: social post cards (post image, truncated linked excerpt, Facebook icon, arrow) that turn into a carousel on mobile.
contentPattern: Dynamic social feed list: each item links to its post detail page and the count varies with the feed; a repeating card structure.

usage.description: Social post cards: post image, truncated linked excerpt, arrow and network icon; 3-column grid on desktop, horizontal swipe carousel on mobile.

reuseGuidance: Use for social media post teasers that link out to the post. Use cards-linked-arrow for internal navigation cards.
tableStructure: One row per post: cell 1 image, cell 2 linked excerpt
